text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where did I leave my water bottle for training camp? I just refilled it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Marvelous! Have you seen my toiletries?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Could that be the pouch with super-marvelous polka-dots?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I may or may not have seen it in my bag! ☆ But it may or may not be mine! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yup, that's it. Gosh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I guess it's okay as long as Marvelous has it. All right, let's head to the bus.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Waaaait! Nature, aren't you taking those babies?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The origami trophies in your closet! ☆ Nature's marvelous treasures! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-wh-what?! H-how did you know about those?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I've noticed you looking at them with a biiiig smile night after night! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gahhh! You were watching me?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, forget whatever you saw! I'm leaving those!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Wow, you're blushing! ☆ Even your shy face is marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's enough! Come on, everyone is waiting for us, so let's get going!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: To summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… It's so hot every time I come here…
choice_data_list: We've got a race coming up, so let's give this camp everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …It's nothiiing. I was just thinking that you're right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho, followed by the Arima Kinen…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: These are both big races. Yup, that's one heavy burden on my shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But… if I do everything I can at this training camp, maybe… I can win…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Either way, I will get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Getting a bit too passionate here. I blame the sun.
And so, Nice Nature's blazing hot summer camp has begun!
